content.text:
This document defines test cases specific to the Opal SSC 1.00, 2.00, 2.01 and 2.02; Opalite SSC 1.00; Pyrite SSC
1.00, 2.00 and 2.01; and Ruby SSC 1.00 specifications. They provide guidance when testing the functionality of an
SD. The test cases are based upon the requirements described in [1] [2] [3] [4] [5] [6].
